What began as a boutique design studio has evolved into one of the fastest-growing private companies in America (Inc. 5000) and among the most effective performance media agencies of the 2020s (Varos) . Our founders were recognized by Forbes 30 Under 30 for advancing the intersection of technology, marketing, and advertising, cementing Darkroom’s role as a defining player in the future of media innovation.

About The Role

Mix-media Video Editor (Video + Motion)

We are hiring a video editor who can own end-to-end content delivery across short‑form video, mixed media and motion‑driven social assets. This is a dedicated in‑house role within our Marketing Team; you will focus exclusively on producing content for Darkroom’s own brand channels to showcase our agency's expertise.

While occasional longer edits still matter, the core of your work will be short‑form social content, performance‑minded cutdowns, and motion‑enhanced storytelling. You will also help define how Darkroom shows up across platforms through consistent, high‑quality video output. This is a fully remote role supporting a team in the EST zone. Candidates based in Portugal, Spain, and Brazil are encouraged to apply.

What You Will Do

Short‑form and Social‑First Editing

  • Edit and produce high‑volume, high‑quality short‑form content for Darkroom across Instagram, TikTok, YouTube Shorts, LinkedIn, and X.
  • Build “thumb‑stopping” edits that land quickly, hold attention, and deliver one clear takeaway.
  • Pull the strongest moments from raw footage, podcasts, webinars, events and internal shoots, then shape them into tight narratives.
  • Create platform‑specific versions of the same concept, including aspect ratio variations and multiple hooks for testing.
  • Deliver A and B variants to support creative learning and performance optimization.

Mixed Media and Motion Design

  • Design and animate motion elements that elevate social edits, including kinetic typography, graphic transitions, and lightweight compositing.
  • Build mixed media layouts that combine video, stills, screen recordings, overlays, and design assets into one cohesive piece.
  • Develop reusable motion templates that speed up production without sacrificing quality.
  • Maintain strong design taste so motion and visuals align with Darkroom branding.

End‑to‑End Ownership

  • Take a reference, script, brief, or rough direction and run with it independently.
  • Manage projects from first cut to final export, including file organization and archiving for future reuse.
  • Collaborate with marketing, strategy, and creative leadership, while staying comfortable making calls when direction is loose.
  • Anticipate bottlenecks and propose clear solutions before they become problems.
  • Hit deadlines consistently without letting quality slip.

Social and Performance Awareness

  • Stay close to what is working on social right now, including trends, pacing, formats, and editing language.
  • Make creative decisions with performance and aesthetics in mind.
  • Use basic performance signals to inform how you cut, structure and hook content over time.

AI and Workflow Acceleration

  • Keep up with emerging tools that can speed up production, like transcription, captioning, audio cleanup, and smart cutdowns.
  • Adopt tools when useful, while keeping final output polished and human.

You Are a Great Fit If You

  • You have 3+ years of editing experience, with a real portfolio of short‑form work.
  • You can edit video and design motion in a way that feels native to social platforms.
  • You have strong mixed media instincts, balancing video, typography, and graphics without clutter.
  • You think like a producer. You do not wait for perfect inputs, you turn rough direction into finished work.
  • You understand hook design, pacing, rhythm and retention mechanics across social formats.
  • You are fast, organized, and steady under pressure, and you can run multiple projects at once.
  • You actively consume social media and can explain why something worked, not just that it worked.
  • You communicate clearly, take feedback well and collaborate with speed and low friction.
  • You care about craft, but you care even more about impact.

Bonus If You

  • You have edited for creators, founders, agencies or brand‑led thought leadership channels.
  • You have worked on performance creative and can connect edits to outcomes.
  • You have experience capturing and editing event content for social distribution.
  • You have built repeatable motion systems or template libraries.
  • You have explored AI tools for editing, motion, or production automation.

What It's Like To Work At Darkroom

We’re building the future of advertising and are looking for the minds to help us do it. Our team is our most sacred asset, and we offer highly competitive salaries and the following perks.

  • Location, location, (or no) location: Remote‑first culture with a strong community base. While many roles remain fully remote, employees hired to work from our New York or Lisbon HQs (opening early 2026) are expected to adopt a hybrid working model, including weekly in‑office appearances. Hub locations also include the Bay Area, Philly, São Paulo, and Barcelona.
  • Endless opportunities for growth: Our agency is founded on an interdisciplinary approach, giving Darkroomers insights into services far beyond your job description. Grow your skills and interests beyond your niche and stay at the forefront of the industry through total immersion in cross‑functional collaboration.
  • Parental Leave: flexible parental leave benefits to support new parents during this important transition, ensuring time to bond with their families while maintaining work‑life balance.

  • Step 3: Avaliação 3 Avaliação

ASPDM - Associação Paulista para o Desenvolvimento da Medicina é uma Associação civil sem fins lucrativos, de natureza filantrópica, reconhecida de utilidade pública federal, estadual e no município de sua sede, respectivamente pelos decretos nos. 57.925, de 04/03/1966, 40.103 de 17/05/1962 e 8.911, de 30/07/1970.

A Instituição atua nos âmbitos federal, estadual e municipal, em harmonia com suas políticas de saúde e de educação, e também como organização social habilitada em vários estados, na gerência de serviços e organizações de saúde, por meio de convênios e contratos de gestão.

A diretriz primordial da Associação é sua inserção no sistema de saúde direcionada ao tratamento, prevenção de doenças e à promoção da saúde primária, secundária e terciária, estreitando laços com a comunidade local e reafirmando seu compromisso social de atender a todos, sem discriminação.

Com o crescimento Institucional, a SPDM vem expandindo sua área de atuação com projetos, em desenvolvimento, na área da Assistência Social e na área Educacional. Toda essa gama de atividades consolida, cada vez mais, a SPDM como uma instituição filantrópica de grande porte, que busca a sustentabilidade econômica, social e ambiental.

Suas quatro superintendências - Hospital São Paulo, Instituições Afiliadas,Programa de Atenção Integral à Saúde e Educação - são gerenciadas por profissionais de alta capacitação técnica e notável saber.

Assim, a SPDM contribui de forma efetiva para a melhoria contínua dos serviços prestados pelo Sistema Único de Saúde do Brasil, visando principalmente garantir a universalidade e as oportunidades de acesso à saúde, necessárias ao desenvolvimento humano e social do cidadão. Para tanto, associa o melhor da tecnologia com atendimento médico de alta qualidade, respaldado por equipes multiprofissionais, formadas por enfermeiros, fisioterapeutas, farmacêuticos, nutricionistas, fonoaudiólogos, bioquímicos, psicólogos, tecnólogos, assistentes sociais e dentistas, entre outros.

O Programa de Atenção Integral à Saúde iniciou suas atividades no ano de 2001 no município de São Paulo, se estendendo para outros municípios e estados. Desde o início de suas atividades, oPAIS busca, em parceria com a gestão pública, o crescimento e a consolidação dos serviços de saúde ofertados aos usuários do SUS.

O Programa tem como objetivo garantir mudanças nos indicadores e na qualidade de vida da população, pautado, entre outros, pelos princípios da integralidade e da equidade, com uma visão estratégica da gestão dos serviços de saúde, definida em um processo de aprimoramento contínuo.

Inclusão

A SPDM oferece oportunidades de trabalho em suas unidades hospitalares, com plano de carreira, para pessoas com deficiência. Para tanto, periodicamente publica anúncio recrutando esses profissionais, nos principais jornais de São Paulo e dos municípios em que se localizam suas unidades.

Missão

Promover ações em saúde integradas com a gestão pública, em benefício da população de forma ética e humanizada, qualidade técnica, com compromisso social e ambiental.

Visão

Ser referência em gestão de serviços em saúde, abrangendo todos os níveis da assistência, garantindo atendimento com qualidade à população dos municípios e estados parceiros.

title: FF&E Supply chain Manager
description:
This position will work closely with Interior Designers and Senior FF&E Procurement Manager to maintain FF&E budgets, project procurement, supply chain, logistics and project installations.

We are seeking a highly organized and experienced FF&E Supply Chain Project Manager to oversee the full logistics, quality control, and delivery process for a luxury residential hospitality project in Brazil. This role is responsible for managing production follow-up, factory coordination, inbound logistics from multiple regions (Brazil and Europe), storage operations in Preá, and final‑mile delivery into Jericoacoara—an area with challenging access conditions.

The ideal candidate has strong project management skills, experience in complex supply‑chain environments, and the ability to work collaboratively with vendors, factories, construction teams, installers, and logistics partners.

At a Glance:

  1. Mid–Senior role overseeing end‑to‑end FF&E supply chain for a luxury hospitality project in Brazil
  2. Responsible for factory supervision, quality control, and production sign‑off (Brazil & Europe)
  3. Manages storage operations in Preá and all inbound logistics
  4. Coordinates last‑mile delivery into Jericoacoara with specialized 4x4/off‑road vehicles
  5. Oversees inventory accuracy, documentation, dispatch & receiving
  6. Plans and supervises loading/unloading, equipment rental, and batch delivery scheduling
  7. Works closely with Construction for delivery timelines, site readiness, and installation planning
  8. Supervises Utopia‑hired installers to ensure deadlines, quality standards, and contractual commitments
  9. Must be highly organized, proactive, and experienced in complex or remote logistics environments

Responsibilities

Production Oversight & Quality Control

  • Supervise FF&E production at each factory (Brazil & Europe).
  • Conduct detailed quality checks and approve inventory before packing and sign‑off.
  • Ensure all items meet Utopia’s standards for quality, specifications, and finishes.

Inbound Logistics & Storage Management

  • Monitor and confirm the arrival of goods at the Preá storage facility.
  • Arrange and oversee loading/unloading operations at all locations.
  • Hire necessary local equipment or machinery as required.
  • Maintain a full, accurate, and continuously updated inventory of all items.

Documentation & Compliance

  • Handle all dispatch, receiving, and transport paperwork.
  • Ensure complete documentation for internal controls and auditing.

Delivery Coordination & Final‑Mile Logistics

  • Oversee delivery schedules from factories to Preá, ensuring timely arrivals.
  • Plan and manage logistics from Preá to Jericoacoara—including batch deliveries due to access restrictions (large trucks cannot cross dunes).
  • Hire and coordinate appropriate 4x4 or off‑road trucks capable of operating in sandy conditions.
  • Supervise all loading/unloading operations for the Preá–Jericoacoara transfers.

On‑Site Coordination & Installation Support

  • Coordinate delivery timelines and equipment needs with the Construction team.
  • Organize and supervise unpacking activities.
  • Oversee Utopia‑hired installation teams to ensure full compliance with contract requirements, deadlines, and quality standards.

Professional Experience

  • 5+ years of experience in FF&E logistics, supply chain management, project management, or procurement—preferably in hospitality or high‑end residential projects.
  • Proven experience supervising factory production, performing quality checks, and managing sign‑off processes.
  • Demonstrated ability to coordinate international and domestic logistics (Brazil + Europe preferred).
  • Experience managing storage facilities, inventory systems, and warehouse operations.
  • Solid track record overseeing loading/unloading operations, equipment rental, and transport coordination.
  • Hands‑on experience with remote or difficult‑access job sites (desert, beach, island, jungle environments are a strong plus).
  • Experience coordinating with construction teams, installers, and multiple vendors simultaneously.
  • Prior responsibility for delivery scheduling, documentation, and compliance.
  • Experience supervising installation teams is highly desirable.
  • Portuguese and English a must - any other language a plus.

Technical Skills

  • Strong knowledge of FF&E manufacturing processes, materials, finishes, and quality standards.
  • Proficiency in inventory management tools, tracking systems, and documentation workflows.
  • Understanding of logistics planning, especially final‑mile or off‑road delivery constraints.
  • Familiarity with transport regulations, customs basics, and dispatch/receiving procedures.
  • Strong reporting and documentation skills (photos, checklists, receiving logs, QC reports).
  • Ability to read technical documents (spec sheets, shop drawings, BOQs).

Salary and benefits are competitive and based on candidate experience.

Note: Please submit your CV in English.

description:
Bluelight is a leading software consultancy dedicated to designing and developing innovative technology that enhances users' lives. With a steadfast commitment to delivering exceptional service to our clients, Bluelight excels in its focus on quality and customer satisfaction. Our mission is not only to create cutting‑edge applications but also to foster a collaborative and enriching work environment where each team member can grow and thrive. With a presence across the United States and Central/South America, Bluelight is in an exciting phase of expansion, continually seeking exceptional talent to join its dynamic and diverse community.

We are looking for a skilled individual to join our rapidly growing team at Bluelight. This position is ideal for someone who thrives in a fast‑paced, dynamic environment where everyone's opinions and efforts are valued and appreciated. You will have the opportunity to contribute to challenging and meaningful projects, developing high‑quality applications that stand out in the market. We value continuous learning, personal growth, and hard work, offering a collaborative environment that promotes professional development. If you are passionate about software development and eager to be part of a growing software consultancy, we invite you to apply and join us on this exciting journey.

About the Role

  • We are looking for a growth‑focused B2B marketer with a strong foundation in paid media and marketing automation. You will be responsible for driving qualified leads to our nearshore staffing solutions using a mix of paid strategies and sophisticated HubSpot automation.
  • You will not just be "buying media", you will be owning the engine that connects innovative US companies with world‑class engineering talent in Latin America. You are well‑versed in Google Campaign Manager, LinkedIn Ads, and HubSpot, and you understand the nuances of marketing complex B2B services to technical decision‑makers.
  • Our ideal candidate thrives on data and uses it to craft high‑performing B2B campaigns. You understand that selling a partnership is different from selling a product, it requires trust, authority, and multiple touch points. You are organized, detail‑oriented, and possess a "White Belt Mentality", always eager to learn and improve. Above all, you are a "Human" first, bringing a positive, engaged personality that strengthens our remote, transparency‑first culture.

Key Responsibilities

  • B2B Media Planning & Strategy:
  • HubSpot Ownership: Serve as the internal subject matter expert for HubSpot. You will not just use it, but optimize it—building workflows, lead scoring models, and attribution reports that connect ad spend to closed client deals.
  • Strategic Planning: Develop comprehensive B2B media plans that target decision‑makers at startups and enterprise companies who need to scale their engineering teams.
  • Market Research: Conduct deep analysis to identify where our target audience (technical leaders) consumes content and how best to reach them.
  • Innovation: Stay abreast of emerging B2B trends, AI integrations in marketing, and new channels for reaching technical talent buyers.
  • Sales Enablement: Advise the New Business and Account teams on recommended budgets and strategies to support their pipeline goals.
  • Campaign Execution & Management:
  • Multi‑Channel Execution: Oversee the execution of paid media campaigns with a heavy focus on LinkedIn Ads (Account‑Based Marketing) and Google Ads (High‑intent search).

Join to apply for the Process Engineer - Relocate to Saudi Arabia, Permanent Expat Relocation Package role at Aramco

This position requires full relocation to Saudi Arabia. It is a permanent full time Expat Relocation Package.

Job Overview

We are seeking a Drilling Foreman to join the Unconventional Resources Drilling Operations Division (URDOD) of Unconventional Resources Drilling Department (URDD).

The URDOD is responsible for direct field responsibility for the drilling or workover of wells located anywhere in the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia and its territorial waters as specified in the well drilling or workover program. Such wells may be exploratory or development and entail the search for or development of hydrocarbon deposits, principally oil and gas.

Your primary role is to direct the drilling or workover of wells located anywhere in the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia and its territorial waters as specified in the well drilling or workover program. Such wells may be exploratory or development and entail the search for or development of hydrocarbon deposits, principally oil and gas.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Supervise work on wells below 15,000 feet or wells complicated by pressure above 10,000 psi, sour gas, highly deviated, or that cost in excess of $10,000,000.
  • Fiscal accountability for Saudi Aramco‑owned equipment and materials, timely communications with Drilling Operations headquarters and logistical co‑ordination of transportation services, materials movement, well services (Saudi Aramco and contractor supplied), water support and roads/location support.
  • Performs Unit level supervisory function at well locations remote to Operations headquarters on a 24 hour per day basis, 28 days on duty, 28 days off work schedule.
  • Directs all well operations efficiently, safely and according to accepted industry practices as outlined and specified in the well Drilling or Workover program issued by the Drilling Engineering Dept.
  • Co‑ordinates the timely ordering of required well materials, equipment and services according to the well program. Documents the receipt, usage and transfer of Saudi Aramco supplied materials and equipment. Reviews service company field tickets for accuracy of services provided and associated charges.
  • Ensures that Saudi Aramco Blowout Prevention Standards are met in all respects including equipment configuration, testing and crew response. Assures that rig and personnel comply with Saudi Aramco established safety standards and procedures.
  • On rigs contracted to Saudi Aramco, assures compliance with terms, conditions and equipment/personnel as specified in the Contract.
  • Provides headquarters a complete daily report of work progress as required in the Daily Morning Report.
  • Promotes cost‑savings ideas and awareness with the view toward operational optimization consistent with safely meeting well objectives.

As the successful candidate you have:

  • Bachelor’s degree in Engineering from a recognized and approved program.

description:
Process Engineer – Relocate to Saudi Arabia, Permanent Expat Relocation Package

Join to apply for the Process Engineer – Relocate to Saudi Arabia, Permanent Expat Relocation Package role at Aramco

This position requires full relocation to Saudi Arabia. It is a permanent full‑time Expat Relocation Package.

Job Overview

We are seeking a Process Engineer to join our Unconventional Resources Producing Department (URPD) within the Unconventional Resource organization.

URPD is responsible for operating and maintaining Unconventional Resources surface facilities, ensuring the safe and efficient production of hydrocarbons. The department plays a critical role in the overall success of the UR program.

Your primary role is to provide professional advice and guidance regarding process systems, schemes, equipment or techniques, facility designs, and solutions to operating and maintenance problems.

Key Responsibilities

  • Provide day‑to‑day technical support to Operations and Maintenance units to troubleshoot and fix process equipment and systems.
  • Develop engineering design packages for new installation and upgrade projects, including development of work scopes, calculations, and detailed technical specifications.
  • Review project proposals and detailed design packages for new facilities.
  • Participate in the testing and commissioning of new facilities and Turnaround and Inspection (T&I).
  • Update and maintain engineering documentation and drawings.
  • Analyze system performance and find solutions for energy saving.
  • Ensure quality, cost‑effective, and timely solutions to any upgrade.
  • Test and pilot new technologies. Ensure full HSE compliance.
  • Report and analyze key performance indices.
  • Make recommendations for technical/economic optimization of existing facilities.
  • Lead feasibility/profitability studies for new facilities. Contribute to Business Unit strategy.
  • Provide analysis, evaluation, and interpretation in support of projects, processes, and financing related to Saudi Aramco capital investment decisions.

Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in Chemical Engineering from an accredited university; a Master’s degree is preferred.
  • Minimum of 15 years of working experience, including 10 years in industrial operation facilities, with a preference for experience in shale gas facilities and modular skids mounted process units.
  • Conversant and working knowledge of industry codes and standards, such as API and ASME codes.
  • Experience with creating/modifying PFDs and P&IDs, troubleshooting process equipment and systems failures, conducting failure analysis and providing recommendations for failed process systems, process simulation software such as HYSIS, creating schematics and piping diagrams, specifying piping and equipment layout, and dealing with corrosion‑related issues.
  • Capable of communicating with multidisciplinary engineers to complete projects and have proven ability to communicate effectively with management at all levels.
  • Able to spot and reconcile conflicting views and interests among different parts of the organization.
  • Able to work effectively with minimal supervision on relatively unstructured tasks and be a hands‑on person who will immediately command the professional respect of others who possess long‑time practical experience.
  • A Professional Engineer (P.E.) or Chartered Engineer (C.Eng.) license or registration is desirable but not essential.
  • Comprehensive understanding of plant operations, process technologies, supply and product logistics, business drivers, cost drivers, and feedstock sensitivities.

Our high‑performing employees are drawn by the challenging and rewarding professional, technical, and industrial opportunities we offer, and are remunerated accordingly.

At Aramco, our people work on truly world‑scale projects, supported by investment in capital and technology that is second to none. Because we face some of the world’s biggest technical, logistical, and environmental challenges, we invest heavily in talent development.

We have a proud history of educating and training our workforce over many decades. Employees at all levels are encouraged to improve their sector‑specific knowledge and competencies through our workforce development programs – one of the largest in the world.

Aramco energizes the world economy.

Aramco occupies a special position in the global energy industry. We are one of the world’s largest producers of hydrocarbon energy and chemicals, with among the lowest upstream carbon intensities of any major producer.

With our significant investment in technology and infrastructure, we strive to maximize the value of the energy we produce for the world along with a commitment to enhance Aramco’s value to society.

Headquartered in the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia, and with offices around the world, we combine market discipline with a generations’ spanning view of the future, born of our nine decades of experience as responsible stewards of the Kingdom’s vast hydrocarbon resources. This responsibility has driven us to deliver significant societal and economic benefits to not just the Kingdom, but also to a vast number of communities, economies, and countries that rely on the vital and reliable energy that we supply.

We are one of the most profitable companies in the world, as well as among the top five global companies by market capitalization.

title: BANCO DE TALENTOS - EXCLUSIVO PARA PESSOA COM DEFICIÊNCIA
description:
A SPDM - Associação Paulista para o Desenvolvimento da Medicina é uma associação civil sem fins lucrativos, de natureza filantrópica, reconhecida de utilidade pública federal, estadual e municipal, conforme decretos nos. 57.925, de 04/03/1966, 40.103 de 17/05/1962 e 8.911, de 30/07/1970.

Atuando nos âmbitos federal, estadual e municipal, a instituição promove políticas de saúde e educação, além de ser uma organização social habilitada em vários estados, gerenciando serviços e organizações de saúde por meio de convênios e contratos de gestão.

A principal diretriz da associação é sua inserção no sistema de saúde, voltada ao tratamento, prevenção de doenças e promoção da saúde em níveis primário, secundário e terciário, fortalecendo laços com a comunidade local e atendendo a todos sem discriminação.

Com o crescimento institucional, a SPDM amplia suas ações com projetos em andamento na área de Assistência Social e Educação, consolidando-se como uma grande instituição filantrópica que busca sustentabilidade econômica, social e ambiental.

Suas quatro superintendências — Hospital São Paulo, Instituições Afiliadas, Programa de Atenção Integral à Saúde (PAIS) e Educação — são gerenciadas por profissionais altamente capacitados.

Disponibilizamos um banco de talentos exclusivo para profissionais com deficiência. Inscreva-se para ser direcionado às vagas disponíveis conforme suas qualificações!

  • Formação de acordo com a área de interesse;
  • Experiência mínima de 6 meses na área;
  • Salário + Benefícios;
  • Escala e horário de trabalho a serem definidos;
  • Locais de trabalho: Zona Norte, Oeste e Centro do Rio de Janeiro;
  • Profissionais de empresas parceiras, fornecedores ou prestadores de serviço, com vínculo de parentesco ou atuação em modalidades contratuais diferentes, devem consultar as normativas de RH vigentes junto ao setor de Recrutamento e Seleção.

A SPDM é uma associação reconhecida por sua atuação social e compromisso com a saúde pública, promovendo ações integradas com a gestão pública, visando garantir acesso universal à saúde, com equipes multiprofissionais de alta qualificação, incluindo enfermeiros, fisioterapeutas, farmacêuticos, nutricionistas, fonoaudiólogos, bioquímicos, psicólogos, tecnólogos, assistentes sociais e dentistas, entre outros.

O Programa de Atenção Integral à Saúde iniciou suas atividades em 2001 na cidade de São Paulo, expandindo-se para outros municípios e estados, buscando melhorar indicadores de saúde e qualidade de vida da população, pautado na integralidade e equidade.

Inclusão

A SPDM oferece oportunidades de trabalho com plano de carreira para pessoas com deficiência em suas unidades hospitalares, realizando periodicamente anúncios de recrutamento nos principais jornais das regiões de atuação.

Missão

Promover ações em saúde integradas à gestão pública, de forma ética, humanizada, com qualidade técnica e compromisso social e ambiental.

Visão

Ser referência na gestão de serviços em saúde, garantindo atendimento de qualidade a toda a população dos municípios e estados parceiros.

ASPDM - Associação Paulista para o Desenvolvimento da Medicina é uma Associação civil sem fins lucrativos, de natureza filantrópica, reconhecida de utilidade pública federal, estadual e no município de sua sede, respectivamente pelos decretos nos. 57.925, de 04/03/1966, 40.103 de 17/05/1962 e 8.911, de 30/07/1970.

A Instituição atua nos âmbitos federal, estadual e municipal, em harmonia com suas políticas de saúde e de educação, e também como organização social habilitada em vários estados, na gerência de serviços e organizações de saúde, por meio de convênios e contratos de gestão.

A diretriz primordial da Associação é sua inserção no sistema de saúde direcionada ao tratamento, prevenção de doenças e à promoção da saúde primária, secundária e terciária, estreitando laços com a comunidade local e reafirmando seu compromisso social de atender a todos, sem discriminação.

Com o crescimento Institucional, a SPDM vem expandindo sua área de atuação com projetos, em desenvolvimento, na área da Assistência Social e na área Educacional. Toda essa gama de atividades consolida, cada vez mais, a SPDM como uma instituição filantrópica de grande porte, que busca a sustentabilidade econômica, social e ambiental.

Suas quatro superintendências - Hospital São Paulo, Instituições Afiliadas,Programa de Atenção Integral à Saúde (PAIS) e Educação - são gerenciadas por profissionais de alta capacitação técnica e notável saber.

Assim, a SPDM contribui de forma efetiva para a melhoria contínua dos serviços prestados pelo Sistema Único de Saúde do Brasil, visando principalmente garantir a universalidade e as oportunidades de acesso à saúde, necessárias ao desenvolvimento humano e social do cidadão. Para tanto, associa o melhor da tecnologia com atendimento médico de alta qualidade, respaldado por equipes multiprofissionais, formadas por enfermeiros, fisioterapeutas, farmacêuticos, nutricionistas, fonoaudiólogos , bioquímicos, psicólogos, tecnólogos, assistentes sociais e dentistas, entre outros.

O Programa de Atenção Integral à Saúde iniciou suas atividades no ano de 2001 no município de São Paulo, se estendendo para outros municípios e estados. Desde o início de suas atividades, oPAIS busca, em parceria com a gestão pública, o crescimento e a consolidação dos serviços de saúde ofertados aos usuários do SUS.

O Programa tem como objetivo garantir mudanças nos indicadores e na qualidade de vida da população, pautado, entre outros, pelos princípios da integralidade e da equidade, com uma visão estratégica da gestão dos serviços de saúde, definida em um processo de aprimoramento contínuo.

Inclusão

A SPDM oferece oportunidades de trabalho em suas unidades hospitalares, com plano de carreira, para pessoas com deficiência. Para tanto, periodicamente publica anúncio recrutando esses profissionais, nos principais jornais de São Paulo e dos municípios em que se localizam suas unidades.

Missão

Promover ações em saúde integradas com a gestão pública, em benefício da população de forma ética e humanizada, qualidade técnica, com compromisso social e ambiental.

Visão

Ser referência em gestão de serviços em saúde, abrangendo todos os níveis da assistência, garantindo atendimento com qualidade à população dos municípios e estados parceiros.

description:
Job description

Desde dezembro de 2015, a SPDM/PAIS é responsável, em parceria com a Secretaria Municipal de Saúde do Rio de Janeiro, pelo gerenciamento do Hospital Municipal Pedro II .

A infraestrutura do Hospital conta com dez andares, nos quais estão distribuídos os serviços de emergência e de Unidade de Tratamento Intensivo (UTI) adulta, pediátrica e neonatal; maternidade; clínica médica, cirurgia-geral e bucomaxilofacial, neurocirurgia, psiquiatria, pediatria e ortopedia. Exames de imagem (raio X, tomografia, ultrassonografia, eletrocardiografia, ecocardiografia) e laboratoriais também são realizados na unidade.

Devido à grande população de idosos da Zona Oeste, região assistida pelo Hospital Municipal Pedro II (HMPII), há duas Enfermarias destinadas ao atendimento desse público.

O Centro de Tratamento de Queimados é outro diferencial entre os serviços oferecidos, e que dispõe de uma UTI exclusiva para prevenir infecções, que podem ser muito graves para quem está com queimaduras.

Além disso, a unidade conta com a Coordenação de Emergência Regional (CER) Santa Cruz, que possui 39 leitos, e tem como objetivo absorver as demandas de menor complexidade, deixando o HMPII liberado para os casos de risco iminente de morte, necessidade de cirurgia urgente e/ou internação. Um diferencial deste CER é o fato de possuir atendimento especializado em Psiquiatria e Obstetrícia.

Main responsibilities

Atuar junto à equipe cirúrgica, se responsabilizando pela organização, quantidade e qualidade do funcionamento do instrumental e de equipamentos a serem utilizados pela equipe cirúrgica, estando atento a controle de reposição e devolução.

Requirements and skills

  • Ensino Técnico Completo em Enfermagem
  • Curso Técnico em Instrumentação Cirúrgica Completo
  • Experiência mínima de 06 meses na função

Additional information

  • Local: Santa Cruz - RJ
  • Escala: 12 horas de trabalho x 60 horas de descanso
  • Horário: 07:00 - 19:00 / 19:00 - 07:00
  • Profissionais de empresas parceiras, fornecedores e/ou prestadores de serviços, vínculo com grau de parentesco ou afinidade no mesmo serviço ou que atuam em outra modalidade contratual (vínculo com o prestador), deverão observar normativas de RH vigentes, através de consulta junto ao setor de Recrutamento e Seleção.

ASPDM - Associação Paulista para o Desenvolvimento da Medicina é uma Associação civil sem fins lucrativos, de natureza filantrópica, reconhecida de utilidade pública federal, estadual e no município de sua sede, respectivamente pelos decretos nos. 57.925, de 04/03/1966, 40.103 de 17/05/1962 e 8.911, de 30/07/1970.

A Instituição atua nos âmbitos federal, estadual e municipal, em harmonia com suas políticas de saúde e de educação, e também como organização social habilitada em vários estados, na gerência de serviços e organizações de saúde, por meio de convênios e contratos de gestão.

A diretriz primordial da Associação é sua inserção no sistema de saúde direcionada ao tratamento, prevenção de doenças e à promoção da saúde primária, secundária e terciária, estreitando laços com a comunidade local e reafirmando seu compromisso social de atender a todos, sem discriminação.

Com o crescimento Institucional, a SPDM vem expandindo sua área de atuação com projetos, em desenvolvimento, na área da Assistência Social e na área Educacional. Toda essa gama de atividades consolida, cada vez mais, a SPDM como uma instituição filantrópica de grande porte, que busca a sustentabilidade econômica, social e ambiental.

Suas quatro superintendências - Hospital São Paulo, Instituições Afiliadas,PAIS e Educação - são gerenciadas por profissionais de alta capacitação técnica e notável saber.

Assim, a SPDM contribui de forma efetiva para a melhoria contínua dos serviços prestados pelo Sistema Único de Saúde do Brasil, visando principalmente garantir a universalidade e as oportunidades de acesso à saúde, necessárias ao desenvolvimento humano e social do cidadão. Para tanto, associa o melhor da tecnologia com atendimento médico de alta qualidade, respaldado por equipes multiprofissionais, formadas por enfermeiros, fisioterapeutas, farmacêuticos, nutricionistas, fonoaudiólogos, bioquímicos, psicólogos, tecnólogos, assistentes sociais e dentistas, entre outros.

O Programa de Atenção Integral à Saúde iniciou suas atividades no ano de 2001 no município de São Paulo, se estendendo para outros municípios e estados. Desde o início de suas atividades, oPAIS busca, em parceria com a gestão pública, o crescimento e a consolidação dos serviços de saúde ofertados aos usuários do SUS.

O Programa tem como objetivo garantir mudanças nos indicadores e na qualidade de vida da população, pautado, entre outros, pelos princípios da integralidade e da equidade, com uma visão estratégica da gestão dos serviços de saúde, definida em um processo de aprimoramento contínuo.

Inclusão

A SPDM oferece oportunidades de trabalho em suas unidades hospitalares, com plano de carreira, para pessoas com deficiência. Para tanto, periodicamente publica anúncio recrutando esses profissionais, nos principais jornais de São Paulo e dos municípios em que se localizam suas unidades.

Missão

Promover ações em saúde integradas com a gestão pública, em benefício da população de forma ética e humanizada, qualidade técnica, com compromisso social e ambiental.

Visão

Ser referência em gestão de serviços em saúde, abrangendo todos os níveis da assistência, garantindo atendimento com qualidade à população dos municípios e estados parceiros.

description:
Join Our Team

Oowlish, one of Latin America's rapidly expanding software development companies, is seeking experienced technology professionals to enhance our diverse and vibrant team.

As a valued member of Oowlish, you will collaborate with premier clients from the United States and Europe, contributing to pioneering digital solutions. Our commitment to creating a nurturing work environment is recognized by our certification as a Great Place to Work, where you will have opportunities for professional development, growth, and a chance to make a significant international impact. We offer the convenience of remote work, allowing you to craft a work-life balance that suits your personal and professional needs.

About the Role

At Oowlish, we help growing brands turn Shopify into a true e-commerce growth engine—not just a storefront . As we evolve from execution-focused delivery to long-term strategic partnership , we’re looking for an E-Commerce (Shopify) Practice Lead to own and scale our Shopify practice.

The core of this position is strategy, consulting, and ownership . You will act as the main point of contact for Shopify clients , deeply understanding their business, diagnosing opportunities, and guiding them toward measurable improvements in Conversion Rate, AOV, UX/UI, SEO, Site‑Speed, Promotions, and overall e‑commerce performance . You’ll work closely with developers and designers by setting priorities, defining scope, and ensuring high‑quality delivery—without being responsible for writing code or implementing features yourself . Your role is to translate business objectives into clear, actionable roadmaps and guide execution through the team, ensuring that work delivered has a measurable business impact .

In addition, this role has a strong commercial and growth component . You will identify upsell and expansion opportunities within existing accounts, contribute to new proposals and pre‑sales conversations , and help position Shopify as a long‑term growth partner for clients . This position is ideal for someone who thinks like a business owner , communicates confidently with stakeholders, and knows how to balance strategy, delivery, and revenue growth within Shopify ecosystems.

Client Ownership & Strategy

  • Act as the primary point of contact for a portfolio of Shopify clients
  • Develop a deep understanding of each client’s business, customers, and goals
  • Proactively identify opportunities to improve conversion, revenue, and user experience
  • Translate business objectives into a clear, prioritized Shopify roadmap

CRO & Performance Optimization

  • Analyze store performance using Shopify Analytics, GA4, and other tools
  • Identify conversion bottlenecks and optimization opportunities across the funnel
  • Propose and prioritize CRO initiatives and experiments
  • Track results and clearly communicate impact to clients

UX/UI Collaboration

  • Work closely with UX/UI designers to ensure designs are conversion‑focused and Shopify‑friendly
  • Provide feedback grounded in usability, performance, and business impact
  • Maintain a high bar for visual quality and user experience

SEO & Shopify Best Practices

  • Ensure Shopify stores follow SEO and performance best practices
  • Collaborate with designers and developers to embed SEO into UX and technical decisions
  • Make smart use of Shopify features, themes, and apps to maximize value

Delivery & Team Coordination

  • Plan and manage the workload of Shopify developers
  • Break initiatives into clear, actionable tasks and priorities
  • Ensure high‑quality, on‑time delivery across all client work
  • Act as a quality gate before work reaches clients

Account Growth & Business Development

  • Identify upsell and expansion opportunities within existing accounts
  • Help scope new initiatives and support sales conversations when needed
  • Strengthen long‑term client relationships by delivering consistent value

Must have

  • 5+ years of experience in e‑commerce, ideally with a strong Shopify focus
  • Proven experience improving conversion rates and online store performance
  • Deep understanding of Shopify (admin, themes, apps ecosystem)
  • Strong knowledge of CRO, UX/UI principles, and SEO fundamentals
  • Experience working closely with developers and designers
  • Excellent communication skills and comfort working directly with clients
  • Fluent or advanced English proficiency (written and spoken) is required, as this role involves direct communication with international clients

Nice to have

  • Experience in an agency or consulting environment
  • Shopify Plus experience
  • Familiarity with tools like Hotjar, Klaviyo, and A/B testing platforms
  • Experience supporting sales or account growth
  • Portuguese and/or Spanish proficiency (written and spoken) is a strong plus, especially for working with international clients

What We Offer

  • Strategic Impact: Redefine how software is built
  • Innovation Hub: A collaborative environment where your vision directly shapes our competitive edge in the market
  • Comprehensive Package: Competitive salary, stock options, and premium benefits

If you enjoy thinking like a business owner , care deeply about great UX , and know how to turn Shopify into a growth engine , we’d love to hear from you.

Company Description

Our Mission

At Palo Alto Networks® everything starts and ends with our mission:

Being the cybersecurity partner of choice, protecting our digital way of life. Our vision is a world where each day is safer and more secure than the one before. We are a company built on the foundation of challenging and disrupting the way things are done, and we’re looking for innovators who are as committed to shaping the future of cybersecurity as we are.

Who We Are

We take our mission of protecting the digital way of life seriously. We are relentless in protecting our customers and we believe that the unique ideas of every member of our team contributes to our collective success. Our values were crowdsourced by employees and are brought to life through each of us everyday - from disruptive innovation and collaboration, to execution. From showing up for each other with integrity to creating an environment where we all feel included.

As a member of our team, you will be shaping the future of cybersecurity. We work fast, value ongoing learning, and we respect each employee as a unique individual. Knowing we all have different needs, our development and personal wellbeing programs are designed to give you choice in how you are supported. This includes our FLEXBenefits wellbeing spending account with over 1,000 eligible items selected by employees, our mental and financial health resources, and our personalized learning opportunities - just to name a few!

Job Description

Your Career

The Regional Sales Manager is a significant driver of company revenue and growth. As an experienced and dynamic sales professional, you’re responsible for leading and driving sales engagements. You’re motivated by the desire to solve critical challenges facing our customer’s secure environment, so you’re prepared to connect them with a solution for every stage of threat prevention.

You’ll be responsible for meeting and exceeding your quota by crafting and implementing strategic territory plans targeting deployments of the Palo Alto Networks Next Generation Security Platform. This is a unique opportunity for a closer with a go‑getter mentality to win business and market share by actively displacing competing technologies.

Palo Alto Networks is leading the charge in platformization, offering best‑in‑breed solutions that enable customers to build a truly zero‑trust security architecture and navigate critical transformations. To ensure our sales team is equipped to guide customers, we've developed FLIGHT, an immersive onboarding program. Flight blends virtual and in‑person learning at our headquarters, where new sales hires will participate in dynamic cohorts, fully dedicated to their training without customer distractions. This focused approach ensures they emerge as well‑prepared sales professionals, ready to help customers leverage our comprehensive portfolio.

Your Impact

  • Drive and orchestrate complex sales cycles and work with our internal partners and teams to best serve the customer.
  • Bring your experience and consultative selling skills to initiate long‑standing relationships with prospective customers and executive sponsors.
  • Create and implement strategic account plans focused on attaining enterprise‑wide deployments.
  • Understand the strategic competitive landscape and customer needs so you can effectively position Palo Alto Networks.
  • Engage a programmatic approach to demand to generate, develop, and expand your territory.
  • Leverage prospect stories to create a compelling value proposition with insights into value for that specific account.
  • Stay updated on industry news and trends, and how they affect Palo Alto Networks products and services.
  • Travel as necessary within your territory, and to company‑wide meetings.

Qualifications

Your Experience

  • Experience and knowledge of SaaS‑based architectures, ideally in a networking and/or security context.
  • Experience cultivating mutually beneficial relationships with our channel partners to bring a channel‑centric go‑to‑market approach for our customers.
  • Have and able to lead all aspects of the sales cycle with the ability to uncover, qualify, develop, and close new, white‑space territories and accounts.
  • Deep knowledge of the (U.S. DOD and/or intelligence community or Civilian Agencies).
  • Possess a successful track record selling complex solutions.
  • Excellent time management skills, and work with high levels of autonomy and self‑direction.
  • Highly competitive, ramp quickly, extremely adaptive, and pride yourself on exceeding production goals.

Additional Information

The Team

Palo Alto Networks has brought technology to market that is reshaping the cybersecurity threat and protection landscape. Our ability to protect digital transactions is limited only by our ability to establish relationships with our potential customers and help them understand how our products can protect their environments. This is where our sales teams come in. Our sales team members work together with large organizations to keep their digital information safe. Our passionate sales teams educate, inspire, and empower our potential clients.

As part of our sales team, you are empowered with unmatched systems and tools, constantly updated research and sales libraries, and a team built on joint success. You won’t find someone at Palo Alto Networks that isn’t committed to your success – with everyone pitching in to assist when it comes to solutions selling, learning, and development. As a member of our sales team, you are motivated by a solutions‑focused sales environment and find fulfillment in working with clients to resolve incredibly complex cyberthreats. You’re an amazing sales person – you’re just looking for something more substantial and challenging as your next step.

Our Commitment

We’re problem solvers that take risks and challenge cybersecurity’s status quo. It’s simple: we can’t accomplish our mission without diverse teams innovating, together.

Overview

Imagine your career taking you to the depths of innovation and the heights of impact. Our people enable continuous progress. Their commitment, collective expertise, and unique capabilities are the engine room behind SBM Offshore’s True. Blue. Transition. - shaping the future of energy, and beyond.

About Us

SBM Offshore is the world’s deepwater ocean‑infrastructure expert. Our work is already resulting in cleaner, more efficient energy production. True. Blue. Transition. is our promise to enable that into the future while at the same time using our expertise to support new and existing markets in the blue economy. It starts with Advancing our Core: continuing to advance the decarbonization of traditional energy production. While Pioneering More: helping to enable the energy transition and using our unique capabilities in ocean infrastructure to support more industries to grow sustainably. Sharing our experience for a better blue tomorrow.

Purpose

As a Senior Data Engineer, you design, develop, and optimize data pipelines and architectures. Ensure alignment with business objectives, manage complex data processing workflows, and enhance data integration and quality. Collaborate with cross‑functional teams to deliver robust data solutions.

Responsibilities

  • Lead and participate in the design, development, and implementation of data engineering solutions with minimal supervision, ensuring adherence to best practices and standards in data engineering.
  • Collaborate with data scientists, analysts, and stakeholders to understand data requirements and ensure the timely delivery of high‑quality data solutions.
  • Design and manage data pipelines, ensuring efficient data flow, processing, and storage from various sources to designated destinations.
  • Develop, test, and deploy data integration processes, including ETL (Extract, Transform, Load) workflows, to ensure data consistency, quality, and reliability.
  • Implement and maintain scalable data architectures, including data lakes, data warehouses, and cloud‑based data solutions, to support the organization’s data needs.
  • Optimize data storage and retrieval performance by designing efficient database schemas, indexing strategies, and partitioning techniques.
  • Monitor and troubleshoot data pipeline performance, addressing any issues related to data quality, latency, or failures promptly and effectively.
  • Collaborate with cross‑functional teams, including IT, product management, and business units, to ensure alignment on data strategies and goals.
  • Mentor and guide junior data engineers, providing technical support, training, and development opportunities to enhance the team’s skills and capabilities.
  • Maintain and optimize technical documentation, including data flow diagrams, data dictionaries, and architecture blueprints, ensuring clear communication and knowledge sharing.
  • Stay current with emerging data engineering technologies, tools, and best practices, applying this knowledge to improve existing processes and solutions.
  • Ensure compliance with data governance policies, data security standards, and regulatory requirements throughout the data engineering lifecycle.
  • Work closely with project managers and SCRUM masters to accurately forecast project timelines, resource needs, and deliverable milestones.

Education

  • Bachelor’s degree in computer science, information technology, data science, or a related field is required. Advanced certifications in data engineering or related fields, such as Google Cloud Professional Data Engineer, AWS Certified Big Data – Specialty, or Microsoft Certified: Azure Data Engineer Associate, are preferred. A Master’s degree in data science, computer science, or a related field is an added advantage but not mandatory. Proficiency in English is essential for effective communication with team members, stakeholders, and external vendors.

Experience

  • Minimum of 7 years of experience in data engineering, data architecture, or a related field, with at least 3 years in a leadership or senior technical role.
  • Proven experience in designing, implementing, and managing complex data pipelines, ETL processes, and data integration solutions.
  • Strong technical background with hands‑on experience in using big data technologies such as Hadoop, Spark, and Kafka, as well as cloud data platforms such as AWS, Azure, or Google Cloud.
  • Demonstrated ability to develop and implement data governance policies, data quality standards, and data security measures to ensure compliance with industry standards and regulatory requirements.
  • Experience with data modelling, data warehousing, and database design using tools such as SQL, NoSQL, and columnar databases.
  • Proficiency in programming languages such as Python, Java, or Scala for data processing and analysis.
  • Strong knowledge of data visualization tools and techniques, with experience in using tools such as Tableau, Power BI, or Looker.
  • Excellent communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to liaise effectively with stakeholders at all levels of the organization.
  • Strong leadership and team‑building skills, with the ability to mentor and guide technical staff to achieve performance goals and objectives.
  • Familiarity with Agile and DevOps methodologies, with a proven ability to implement continuous integration and continuous delivery (CI/CD) pipelines.
  • Relevant certifications such as Google Cloud Professional Data Engineer, AWS Certified Big Data – Specialty, or Microsoft Certified: Azure Data Engineer Associate are preferred.

Functional Competencies

  • Compliance
  • Governance, Risk and Control
  • Analytics and reporting
  • IT Tools and application
  • Cost and budget control
  • Business Partnering
  • Digital savvy
  • Business Acumen

Job Overview

We are seeking a Plant Corrosion Engineer to join the Riyas Engineering Division (RNGLFD) which is part of the Riyas NGL Fractionation Dept (RNGLFD). RNGLFD is responsible for two trains, each designed to process 255 MBOD (242.25 MBCD). Each train will include fractionation units, C3 & C4 treatment, C3 & C4 dehydration and propane refrigeration. The common facilities will include feed and product surge storage, chemicals storage and utilities including, but not limited to, steam and condensate recovery systems, utility water, plant, instrument air and nitrogen systems, machinery cooling water, drainage and flare systems. Some of the systems (e.g., steam headers, flare headers, product storage) have been pre‑invested for the future train.

Your primary role will be to implement, support and continually improve RNGLFD inspection corrosion management programs and provide consolatory advice in materials, ensuring cost‑effective material selection and corrosion mitigation strategies, which will ensure mechanical integrity of the materials, applied on all plant assets including equipment and piping through their life cycle.

Key Responsibilities

  • Implement corrosion management program and on‑stream monitoring and Conduct risk‑based inspection based on API‑580 methodology.
  • Review and approve recommended solutions for coating failures and cathodic protection and participate in Hazard and Operability Study (HAZOP) review sessions and ensure that all issues are addressed.
  • Manage water treatment program and recommend solutions to overcome challenges and review design packages and validate materials selection based on current code and standards.

description:
Job description

A Estratégia Saúde da Família consiste em uma reorientação do modelo assistencial, realizada mediante a implantação de equipes multiprofissionais em Clínicas de Saúde da Família. Estas equipes ficam responsáveis pelo acompanhamento de um número definido de famílias de áreas geográficas delimitadas, atuando com ações de prevenção e promoção à saúde dessa comunidade.

As equipes da ESF são compostas por Médico Generalista ou Médico de Família e Comunidade, Enfermeiro, Auxiliar ou Técnico de Enfermagem e Agentes Comunitários de Saúde (ACS).

Também há equipe de Saúde Bucal, composta por cirurgião-dentista generalista ou especialista em saúde da família, auxiliar e/ou técnico em Saúde Bucal.

Main responsibilities

Promover ações de apoio matricial às equipes de saúde da família com o intuito de qualificar e ampliar o escopo das ações da atenção básica bem como qualificar a situação de saúde da população. Apoiar as equipes de saúde na família na realização do manejo das situações de saúde mental e risco psicossocial na atenção básica, propiciando, ainda, o acesso ao sistema de saúde e à reinserção social.

Requirements and skills

  • Ensino Superior Completo em Medicina;
  • Especialização ou Residência em Psiquiatria com RQE;
  • Registro Ativo no Conselho da Classe;
  • Preencher os requisitos da Resolução SMS 4871 de 13 de Abril de 2021, a saber:

RESOLVE: Art. 1º Define como requisito obrigatório para a atuação na equipe multiprofissional do Núcleo de Apoio à Saúde da Família e Atenção Básica (NASF-AB) ao menos 2 (dois) dos critérios abaixo:

§1º Ter no mínimo 3 (três) anos de experiência de atuação direta no saúde da família ou no núcleo de apoio à saúde da família.

§2º Ter no mínimo 5 (cinco) anos de experiência profissional na área da saúde.

§3º Ter no mínimo 3 (três) anos de experiência de atuação em um centro de atenção psicossocial (CAPS).

§4º Certificado de conclusão de pós-graduação stricto sensu em saúde da família, saúde pública ou saúde coletiva.

§5º Certificado de conclusão de residência ou pós-graduação lato sensu em saúde.

§6º Título de especialista reconhecido pela associação médica brasileira (AMB).

§7º Ter participado de 3 (três) atividades de atualização científica e/ou acadêmica nas áreas: Saúde da Família, Medicina, Saúde Pública e Saúde Coletiva (congressos, seminários, workshop, capacitações em cursos presenciais ou à distância) nos últimos dois anos antes da contratação.

  • Planejamento, implementação, checagem e atuação (PDCA) nas 15 diretrizes, verificando o atendimento aos requisitos estabelecidos no Sistema de Gestão de SMS, Normas e outros requisitos legais aplicáveis;
  • Implementação de ferramentas do Sistema de Gestão de SMS, tais como: Programa de Administração de Desvios (PAD), Comitê de SMS e RAC anual de SMS, emitindo relatórios utilizando sistemas informatizados (audicomp, audicomp BW, sisin BW, Portal de Gestão, dentre outros) e controles em Excel e Power BI, avaliando os dados, gráficos, tendências e propondo ações para corrigir os desvios observados, incluindo àqueles relativos à tendência de indicadores de SMS;
  • Implementação, monitoramento e avaliação do processo de Gestão da Conformidade Legal em SMS, estabelecendo as orientações necessárias, de forma a assegurar o atendimento aos requisitos legais aplicáveis às áreas de abrangênc.
  • Atuar ativamente durante a realização de Verificação de Conformidade Legal (VCL) da UIE;
  • Atuação na elaboração, monitoramento e divulgação aos envolvidos do cumprimento do Plano de Objetivos, Indicadores, Metas e Programa de SMS do empreendimento;
  • Semanalmente, providência de material e apresentação do Momento de Segurança à força de trabalho;
  • Elaboração e monitoramento do cronograma de aplicação de Listas de Verificação (LV) de SMS visando avaliar os requisitos legais e contratuais, de forma alinhada à fase da obra (mobilização, construção, montagem, testes, comissionamento, pré-operação, partida etc);

  • Mensalmente, extração e análise crítica dos resultados oriundos da aplicação de LVs do SALV2 ou sistema equivalente e das pendências;
  • Análise qualitativa dos programas e documentos de Segurança da Empresa Executora da Obra formalizando os comentários no GED4 ou sistema equivalente. A análise deve contemplar minimamente orientações de necessidades de correção e/ou aprimoramento, sempre embasado no contrato firmado entre a Empresa Executora da Obra, nos procedimentos vigentes, legislação e melhores práticas;
  • Registro em sistema apropriado da realização do gerenciamento de mudanças de instalação, tecnologia e pessoas, em conformidade com procedimento interno;
  • Planejamento, programação e execução de treinamentos de SMS, incluindo integração, corporativos para colaboradores da UIE e da Empresa Executora da Obra;
  • Participação nas ações de planejamento, preparação, organização de evidências para as Auditorias de SMS internas (tais como APIR, PAG, VCL, ADC) e externas, acompanhando tais auditorias e, após o término, registrando as não conformidades em sistema apropriado e atuando para implementar as ações de correção;
  • Realização mensal de Índice de Práticas Seguras (IPS) e Auditoria Comportamental, de forma alinhada ao procedimento interno;
  • Implementação e monitoramento de ações corporativas de SMS. Apoio à Empresa Executora da Obra na implementação de ações corporativas de SMS, tais como ações geradas em decorrência de necessidade de abrangência de acidentes e incidentes ocorridos em outro empreendimento, programas corporativos, dentre outros;
  • Participação em reuniões periódicas de SMS, incluindo reuniões com a Empresa Executora da Obra, sugerindo a implementação de ações quando verificados pontos de atenção e realizando o monitoramento da implementação e da qualidade das ações realizadas pela Empresa Executora da Obra. Proceder ao registro das reuniões (atas), conforme estabelecido internamente;
  • Efetuação de registros de anomalias de SMS em sistema informatizado;
  • Monitoramento periódico da implementação das ferramentas de SMS (IPS, Audicomp, VCP, LVs do SALV2 ou sistema equivalente e Big Five, pela Fiscalização e pela Empresa Executora da Obra;
  • Atuação junto à Fiscalização com relação às dúvidas relativas à Gestão de Segurança.

title: Rotating Equipment Engineer - Relocate to Saudi Arabia, Permanent Expat Relocation Package
description:
Rotating Equipment Engineer – Relocate to Saudi Arabia, Permanent Expat Relocation Package

Join to apply for the Rotating Equipment Engineer – Relocate to Saudi Arabia, Permanent Expat Relocation Package role at Aramco

This position requires full relocation to Saudi Arabia. It is a permanent full‑time expat relocation package.

Job Overview

We are seeking a Rotating Equipment Engineer to join our Unconventional Resources Producing Department (URPD) within the Unconventional Resources organization.

The URPD is responsible for operating and maintaining Unconventional Resources (UR) surface facilities, ensuring the safe and efficient production of hydrocarbons. The department plays a critical role in the overall success of the UR program.

Your primary role is to provide professional advice and guidance regarding mechanical/rotating equipment systems, schemes, equipment, or techniques, facility designs, and solutions to operating and maintenance problems.

Key Responsibilities

  • Provide day‑to‑day technical support to Operations and Maintenance Units to troubleshoot and fix rotating equipment and mechanical systems.
  • Develop engineering design packages for new installation and upgrade projects, including development of work scopes, calculations, and detailed technical specifications.
  • Review Project Proposals and Detailed Design packages for new facilities.
  • Participate in the testing and commissioning of new facilities and Turnaround and Inspection (T&I).
  • Update and maintain engineering documentation and drawings.
  • Analyze system performance and find solutions for energy saving.
  • Ensure quality, cost‑effective, and timely solutions to any upgrade.
  • Test and pilot new technologies. Ensure full HSE compliance.
  • Report and analyze key performance indices.
  • Develop and implement reliability programs.
  • Make recommendations for technical/economic optimization of existing facilities and lead feasibility/profitability studies for new facilities.
  • Provide analysis, evaluation, and interpretation in support of projects, processes, and financing related to Saudi Aramco capital investment decisions.

Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in Mechanical Engineering from an accredited university; a Master’s degree is preferred.
  • 15 years of working experience, including 10 years in industrial operation facilities, with preference for experience in shale gas facilities and modular skid‑mounted units.
  • Knowledge of industry codes and standards such as ASME and API (including API‑STD‑610 and 617).
  • Experience with creating/modifying PFDs and P&IDs, troubleshooting and major repair of oil and gas rotating equipment, creating schematics and piping diagrams, conducting failure analysis, and providing recommendations for failed rotating equipment.
  • Experience in rotating equipment and piping field installation, commissioning, and testing, and specifying piping and equipment layout.
  • Strong written and oral communication skills; ability to communicate complex technical, economic, and commercial concepts clearly to diverse audiences.
  • Ability to work independently with minimal supervision on unstructured tasks and command professional respect.
  • P.E. or Chartered Engineer license desirable but not essential.
  • Thorough understanding of plant operations, process technologies, supply and product logistics, business and cost drivers, and feedstock sensitivities.
  • Experience in mechanical design review, construction, commissioning, and testing activities for new shale gas facilities.

Seniority Level

Mid‑Senior level

Employment Type

Full‑time

Job Function

Engineering, Project Management, and Manufacturing

Industry

Oil and Gas

At Aramco, our employees are drawn by challenging and rewarding professional, technical and industrial opportunities and are remunerated accordingly.

Aramco has a proud history of educating and training our workforce, encouraging continuous improvement through one of the largest workforce development programs in the world.

Aramco energizes the world economy.

title: PROFISSIONAL DE ENGENHARIA CIVIL (ESTRUTURAS METÁLICAS) - RIO DE JANEIRO/RJ
description:
A SANDECH foi fundada em 2008, na cidade do Rio de Janeiro, com o propósito de desenvolver projetos multidisciplinares para o setor industrial. Desde então, temos atuado em diversos segmentos da economia brasileira, como óleo e gás, químico e petroquímico, farmacêutico e siderúrgico. Até então, já entregamos mais de 800 projetos, consolidando um portfólio robusto com clientes de grande porte, como Petrobras, BRASKEM, Modec, PRIO, Nestlé e Gerdau. Com foco em inovação, a SANDECH adota tecnologias avançadas, como drones, laser scan, integração ao modelo BIM e óculos de realidade virtual, sempre buscando otimizar processos e elevar o nível de precisão e eficiência de seus projetos. Esse compromisso com a excelência também se reflete no Sistema de Gestão da Qualidade, certificado internacionalmente pela ABS Quality Evaluations na norma ISO 9001:2015 e aprovado em auditorias realizadas por cinco de seus principais clientes. Com um SGQ maduro e bem estruturado, estamos habilitados a executar projetos de engenharia considerados críticos. Mais do que uma empresa de engenharia, a SANDECH se posiciona como um parceiro estratégico de seus clientes, unindo experiência técnica, inovação e qualidade. Em constante crescimento, buscamos profissionais comprometidos com a excelência e com a construção de soluções cada vez mais eficientes e sustentáveis para a indústria brasileira.

RESPONSABILIDADES

  • Atuar no desenvolvimento de projetos estruturais (metálicos e/ou de concreto armado), tanto no dimensionamento quanto no detalhamento;
  • Realizar tratativas técnicas com o cliente ao longo do projeto, quando necessário;

title: Técnico de Segurança do Trabalho – Rede Hospital Casa – Zona Norte
description:
Técnico de Segurança do Trabalho – Rede Hospital Casa – Zona Norte

Suas principais atividades serão:

· Aplicar os conhecimentos técnicos de Segurança do Trabalho de modo a reduzir, neutralizar ou eliminar os riscos à segurança do trabalhador;

· Orientar o sistema de segurança do trabalho, investigando riscos e causas de acidentes, fazendo as necessárias recomendações para evitar acidentes semelhantes, analisando esquemas de prevenção, observando dispositivos legais e institucionais que objetivem a eliminação, controle ou redução permanente dos riscos de acidentes do trabalho e a melhoria das condições do ambiente, para preservar a integridade física e mental dos trabalhadores;

· Inspecionar locais, instalações e equipamentos da empresa e determinar fatores de riscos de acidentes;

· Realizar auditorias internas e treinamentos de Segurança do Trabalho em todos os Setores da unidade Hospitalar, de forma rotineira, identificando condições insalubres e perigosas, tomando todas as providências necessárias para eliminar as situações de riscos, bem como orientar e conscientizar os colaboradores quanto a atitudes de segurança no trabalho;

· Elaborar e implementar política de saúde, segurança do trabalho e meio ambiente (SSMA);

· Exigir o cumprimento das condições básicas de Segurança do Trabalho para empresas prestadoras de serviço e contratadas para execução de serviços nas dependências do estabelecimento hospitalar;

· Acompanhar de forma permanente as atividades realizadas pela CIPA, estudando suas observações e propostas, visando a adoção das soluções corretivas e preventivas de acidentes do trabalho e meio ambiente dela valendo-se como agente multiplicador;

· Controlar, distribuir e inspecionar os equipamentos de proteção individual (EPI);

· Elaborar documentos de segurança do trabalho como Programa de Prevenção de Riscos Ambientais, dentre outros;

· Fazer inspeção em equipamentos de proteção contra incêndio, recursos audiovisuais e didáticos e outros materiais considerados indispensáveis, de acordo com a legislação vigente;

· Propor normas e dispositivos de segurança, sugerindo eventuais modificações nos equipamentos e instalações e verificando sua observância, para prevenir acidentes;

· Inspecionar os postos de combate a incêndios, examinando as mangueiras, hidrantes, extintores e equipamentos de proteção contra incêndios;

· Comunicar os resultados de suas inspeções à coordenação do SESMT, elaborando relatórios;

· Investigar acidentes ocorridos, examinando as condições da ocorrência, para identificar suas causas e propor as providências cabíveis;

· Intermediar junto aos serviços médico e social da instituição, visando facilitar o atendimento necessário aos acidentados;

· Registrar irregularidades e elaborar estatísticas de acidentes;

· Promover campanhas, cursos, palestras e outras formas de treinamento com o objetivo de divulgar as normas de segurança e higiene do trabalho, bem como informar e conscientizar os trabalhadores sobre atividades insalubres, perigosas e penosas;

· Dar suporte às perícias judiciais, à Medicina do trabalho conforme a deliberação da Coordenação do SESMT.

· Acompanhar as atividades pela enfermagem, hotelaria, serviços de higiene e limpeza, nutrição, com objetivo de assegurar as normas legais internas em segurança do trabalho;

· Participar de reuniões sobre segurança no trabalho, fornecendo dados relativos ao assunto, apresentando sugestões e analisando a viabilidade de medidas de segurança propostas, para aperfeiçoar o sistema existente;

· Executar tarefas pertinentes à área de atuação, utilizando-se de equipamentos e programas de informática;

· Executar e apoiar outras tarefas para o desenvolvimento das atividades do Setor, inerentes à sua Função;

· Trabalhar em conformidade com as normas e procedimentos técnicos e de qualidade, segurança, meio ambiente, higiene e saúde.

description:
Turnaround & Inspection Engineer – Relocate to Saudi Arabia – Permanent Expat Relocation Package

4 days ago Be among the first 25 applicants

This position requires full relocation to Saudi Arabia. It is a permanent full-time Expat relocation package.

Job Overview

We are seeking a Turnaround & Inspection Engineer to join the Riyas NGL Fractionation Maintenance Division (RNGLFMD) of the Riyas NGL Fractionation Department (RNGLFD). RNGLFMD is responsible for two NGL Fractionation trains, each designed to process 255 MBOD (242.25 MBCD). Each train includes fractionation units, C3 & C4 treatment, C3 & C4 dehydration and propane refrigeration. Common facilities include feed and product surge storage, chemicals storage, and utilities such as boilers, steam, condensate recovery, water, instrument air, nitrogen, cooling water, drainage, and flare systems.

Your primary role is to carry out full-cycle Turnaround & Inspection (T&I) from planning to final execution and closure, including cost estimation, scheduling, coordination with engineering, inspection, and operations to define the most comprehensive T&I scope of work. You will develop detailed job plans for identified T&I scopes and plan all required materials, identifying long-lead items to ensure availability prior to execution.

Key Responsibilities

  • Develop annual Turnaround & Inspection plan for all minor & major T&I with accurate budgeting.
  • Issue detailed post T&I report covering all events, findings, costs & scheduling performance, and lessons learned.
  • Coordinate maintenance programs with user units to determine priorities and on-time completion of work in critical operating facilities.
  • Assign maintenance manpower within your area to meet daily changes in operating requirements and priorities.
  • Recommend special work schedules, overtime or contractor participation to meet unusual or emergency situations.
  • Plan assigned T&I field-wide, analyze and sequence all work requests; estimate required manpower, and justify additional requests for manpower, overtime or downtime extension.
  • Ensure that all material and equipment details are available at the jobsite; direct Maintenance Engineers when necessary.
  • Report to the concerned Maintenance Supervisor on quality, quantity of workmanship and adherence to standards.
  • Recommend improved work methods.
  • Report deviations from approved schedules and assist in corrective actions.
  • Review project proposals to ensure maintenance aspects are considered in final design.
  • Coordinate maintenance work between divisions when services from various divisions are required.
  • Perform special assignments as directed, utilizing engineering knowledge. May include Digital Maintenance Engineering tasks such as real-time process control analysis, fault diagnosis, and complex hardware problem resolution.

Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in Mechanical Engineering.
  • Minimum of 15 years of experience in Turnaround and Inspection (T&I) of gas plants.
  • Demonstrated experience in Primavera P6 professional software and PMI-Scheduling (or equivalent).
  • Preferred PMI-PMP certificate (or equivalent).
  • Certified Cost Professional (CCP) certification is preferred.

Job description

Desde dezembro de 2015, a SPDM/PAIS é responsável, em parceria com a Secretaria Municipal de Saúde do Rio de Janeiro, pelo gerenciamento do Hospital Municipal Pedro II .

A infraestrutura do Hospital conta com dez andares, nos quais estão distribuídos os serviços de emergência e de Unidade de Tratamento Intensivo (UTI) adulta, pediátrica e neonatal; maternidade; clínica médica, cirurgia-geral e bucomaxilofacial, neurocirurgia, psiquiatria, pediatria e ortopedia. Exames de imagem (raio X, tomografia, ultrassonografia, eletrocardiografia, ecocardiografia) e laboratoriais também são realizados na unidade.

Devido à grande população de idosos da Zona Oeste, região assistida pelo Hospital Municipal Pedro II (HMPII), há duas Enfermarias destinadas ao atendimento desse público.

O Centro de Tratamento de Queimados é outro diferencial entre os serviços oferecidos, e que dispõe de uma UTI exclusiva para prevenir infecções, que podem ser muito graves para quem está com queimaduras.

Além disso, a unidade conta com a Coordenação de Emergência Regional (CER) Santa Cruz, que possui 39 leitos, e tem como objetivo absorver as demandas de menor complexidade, deixando o HMPII liberado para os casos de risco iminente de morte, necessidade de cirurgia urgente e/ou internação. Um diferencial deste CER é o fato de possuir atendimento especializado em Psiquiatria e Obstetrícia.

Main responsibilities

Criar um ambiente seguro e confiável para que seja possível trabalhar a socialização e independência do usuário, bem como o seu protagonismo, levando em consideração o contexto de vida e projeto terapêutico.

Requirements and skills

Ensino Superior Completo em Terapia Ocupacional

Pós-Graduação completa em uma ou mais das áreas citadas a seguir: Neurofuncional, Traumato-ortopedica ou Residência Multiprofissional em Saúde Registro Ativo no Conselho da Classe
